highlights: OpenAI is aggressively expanding its market reach with new enterprise AI agent platforms, specialized health integrations, and programs for small businesses, alongside significant infrastructure investments.
Google is enhancing its developer ecosystem with expanded agent capabilities in the Gemini API and seamless app integrations with Search, while also pushing boundaries in medical AI research.

The broader AI community is seeing advancements in model efficiency (4-bit diffusion inference), streamlined MLOps workflows (cloud integrations), and robust tools for physical AI and robotics development.

agents.title: Introducing OpenAI Presence
agents.summary: OpenAI Presence is an enterprise AI agent platform for deploying trusted voice and chat agents to automate customer and internal workflows, providing a direct solution for organizations.

agents.title: Expanding Managed Agents in Gemini API: background tasks, remote MCP and more
agents.summary: Google expands Managed Agents in Gemini API with new capabilities like background tasks and remote MCP, enabling developers to build reliable, production-ready agents.

agents.title: LeRobot v0.6.0: Imagine, Evaluate, Improve
agents.summary: LeRobot v0.6.0 is released, offering improved features for imagining, evaluating, and enhancing robotic AI systems, crucial for developers building physical AI agents.

models.title: Safety and alignment in an era of long-horizon models
models.summary: OpenAI shares insights on deploying long-running AI models, detailing emerging safety risks, observed failures, and improved safeguards through iterative development, crucial for builders creating persistent AI systems.

models.title: Bringing Nunchaku 4-bit Diffusion Inference to Diffusers
models.summary: Nunchaku 4-bit diffusion inference is now integrated into Diffusers, enabling significantly more efficient and faster deployment of diffusion models, crucial for optimizing resource usage.

models.title: New research shows how AMIE, our medical AI, could help manage health conditions.
models.summary: New research published in Nature demonstrates Google's conversational AI system, AMIE, matching primary care physicians in complex disease management, showcasing advanced medical AI application.

tools.title: Connect more of your apps to Search
tools.summary: Google is enabling users to securely link and interact with their preferred services directly within AI Mode in Search, opening new integration possibilities for app developers.

tools.title: Native-speed vLLM transformers modeling backend
tools.summary: A new native-speed vLLM transformers modeling backend is introduced, providing significant performance enhancements for large language model inference and deployment, boosting builder efficiency.

tools.title: Run AI workloads on any cloud, store on Hugging Face: zero-egress storage with SkyPilot
tools.summary: SkyPilot now supports running AI workloads across any cloud while storing data on Hugging Face with zero-egress, enabling flexible and cost-effective multi-cloud deployments for developers.

companies.title: Launching Health in ChatGPT
companies.summary: ChatGPT now securely integrates medical records and Apple Health for eligible U.S. users, offering personalized health insights and expanding AI's role in healthcare.

companies.title: Introducing the ChatGPT for small business program
companies.summary: OpenAI launched a program to help small businesses develop AI skills, automate operations, and grow using ChatGPT Work, democratizing AI access for entrepreneurs.

companies.title: Building AI infrastructure with the Effingham County community
companies.summary: OpenAI announced Project Camellia, a major infrastructure investment in Georgia, emphasizing responsible energy, community development, and local access to AI technologies.

learning.title: A scorecard for the AI age
learning.summary: OpenAI's CFO introduces a practical AI scorecard to measure ROI through useful work, cost per successful task, dependability, and return on compute, providing a framework for business leaders.

learning.title: Ask an AI expert: What exactly is the full stack?
learning.summary: A Google expert explains the concept of a full-stack AI approach, clarifying its foundational importance in developing robust AI systems for practitioners.

learning.title: Profiling in PyTorch (Part 3): Attention is all you profile
learning.summary: This technical tutorial focuses on advanced profiling techniques in PyTorch, specifically for optimizing attention mechanisms in deep learning models, crucial for performance tuning.
